environment_setting: Country B, City X, a bustling metropolitan area with a major international airport known for its strict security measures.
norm_base: Citizens Taking offensive weapons or explosive substances aboard civil aircraft without proper authorization Imprisonment up to 14 years

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: to expose airport security flaws for a sensational story

legitimate.legitimate_action: Conducting interviews and research to highlight airport security issues without violating laws
legitimate.benefits: Gains credibility as a journalist, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Requires significant time and effort, may not yield sensational results

illegal.illegal_action: Attempting to smuggle a fake explosive device aboard a civil aircraft to test security
illegal.benefits: Potentially exposes major security flaws, gains widespread attention and fame
illegal.costs: Imprisonment up to 14 years if caught, loss of reputation, legal fees

character_profile.name: Alice Smith
character_profile.goal: to ensure the safety of passengers and staff

legitimate.legitimate_action: Thoroughly inspecting passengers and luggage to prevent unauthorized items from being brought aboard
legitimate.benefits: Maintains airport security, fulfills professional duty
legitimate.costs: High stress and workload, potential conflicts with passengers

illegal.illegal_action: Neglecting thorough inspections to save time and reduce workload
illegal.benefits: Reduces personal stress and workload, avoids passenger complaints
illegal.costs: If a security breach occurs, faces disciplinary action or legal consequences

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: to complete his shift with minimal effort

legitimate.legitimate_action: Following standard procedures to ensure all luggage is properly screened and handled
legitimate.benefits: Avoids disciplinary action, ensures passenger safety
legitimate.costs: Requires effort and attention to detail, increases workload

illegal.illegal_action: Skipping proper screening of certain luggage to save time
illegal.benefits: Reduces workload, finishes tasks more quickly
illegal.costs: If a security breach occurs, faces termination or legal consequences
